name: expense-webapp
description: The browser app every employee, manager and finance reviewer uses: draft and submit claims with receipt images, work the manager approval queue, work the finance review queue, and download the payroll export file. A React single-page app that calls the Expense API with the signed-in user's token; each screen gates on the operation it loads and the three roles see different queues and actions. It owns no data of its own, renders no sign-in form (Thunder hosts it), and talks only to the Expense API.

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: The API every screen loads: drafts, submissions, approval queues, finance review and the payroll export download.

dependencies.name: expense-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder sign-in client the SPA redirects to; returns the signed-in user with their role groups for screen gating.
